name: D07_8_only_creatures_count_a_noncreature_with_power_does_not
notes: Printed: 'When this enchantment enters, if you control a CREATURE with power 4 or greater, draw a card.' and 'Whenever a CREATURE you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.' My only permanent with power 4 or more is an uncrewed Vehicle (an artifact with a 5/5 printed P/T), which is not a creature. The Uprising is cast and enters: no draw. A second Vehicle (a 6/6) then enters under my control with the Uprising in play: no draw either. The hand holds only the last Vehicle's slot (0 cards) and the library keeps all six cards.
